*Example 1 (direct and relevant):*  
"I earned a Bachelor’s degree in [Major, e.g., Computer Science, Business Administration, Psychology] from [University]. My coursework included [relevant subjects], which helped me build a strong foundation in [skills or knowledge relevant to the job]."

"I hold a Bachelor’s degree in [Major] from [University]. While my academic background is in [field], I’ve developed strong skills in [e.g., analytical thinking, communication, project management] through my studies and experiences, which I’ve applied in my professional work."

"I’m currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in [Major] at [University], and I expect to graduate in [month/year]. My studies have provided me with a solid understanding of [relevant topics], and I’ve complemented this with practical experience through internships and projects."
